Monitor command argument, permission, and execution prototypes plus action declaration.

# Purpose
This header file declares the interface for the `monitor` command in the shared command set. It includes the configuration and action definitions needed by the command code and uses `FD_PROTOTYPES_BEGIN` and `FD_PROTOTYPES_END` to keep the function declarations compatible with C and C++ builds. The file declares three command entry points: [`monitor_cmd_args`](<#monitor_cmd_args>) for argument processing, [`monitor_cmd_perm`](<#monitor_cmd_perm>) for permission checks, and [`monitor_cmd_fn`](<#monitor_cmd_fn>) for command execution. It also declares the external `fd_action_monitor` action object used to register or reference the command.
